data.body: INVESTIGATION: This bug requires retroactive CI reviews of PRs #49+, not a code fix. The CI review gate was broken (ModuleNotFoundError: litellm) during those merges. To resolve: (1) re-run CI llm-review on each affected PR and remediate any critical/important findings, or (2) user explicitly accepts the historical state and closes. Leaving open pending user decision. No code change is possible for the historical state.
